card.name: Linking words before hypertension terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation or spaces right before a blood-pressure term such as hypertensive crisis, high blood pressure, antihypertensive agents or a diuretic. The marked word is a link, not the term itself.

modes.label: Before high blood pressure
modes.description: A space or the word 'with' after a blood pressure reading, just before the diagnosis or numbers.
modes.example: If your blood pressure reading is high, you will probably be asked to come back for repeat blood pressure checks. If you have three visits with readings over<< >>140/90 mmHG

modes.label: Before hypertensive crisis or antihypertensive drugs
modes.description: A comma, 'including', 'with' or 'a' that leads into hypertensive crisis, other antihypertensive agents or a diuretic.
modes.example: 5.8 Hypertension Significant elevation in blood pressure,<< including>> hypertensive crisis with acute impairment of organ

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting word just before a blood pressure or hypertension term is about to appear.
